task: Fix unique(items) in solution.py to preserve first occurrence order, support unhashable values, and leave its input unchanged.

files.test_solution.py:
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
m = runpy.run_path(str(Path.cwd() / 'solution.py'))
def test_unique():
    f = m['unique']
    a = [[2], [1], [2]]
    assert f(a) == [[2], [1]]
    assert a == [[2], [1], [2]]
    assert f([3, 1, 3, 2]) == [3, 1, 2]
    assert f([]) == []
